entries.zh: 马刺（骑者靴跟所戴的刺具，用以催马；原稿汉字作“馬后踢”，谓刺马则马向后踢）
entries.en: spur (metal spike worn on the rider's heel to urge the horse; Chinese gloss lit. “the horse kicks backward”)

entries.zh: 簧（笙笛类管乐器上发声的竹制簧片）；西语词头辨读存疑
entries.en: reed (bamboo tongue of a pipe or musical instrument)
entries.notes: L 栏 Espuesta p̃(=para) acanear 中 espuesta/acanear 均为罕见词形、展开依赖推断，释义以汉字“簧”为准

entries.zh: 簧管（汉字栏字迹难辨：疑“算”或“簧”；据同词头与读音当为管乐器之簧）
entries.en: reed pipe / reed of a wind instrument (character uncertain between 算 and 簧)
entries.notes: 汉字栏“算/簧”难辨且官话栏空，义据 L 栏同词头（同第 2 条 espuesta para acanear）推为簧类

entries.zh: 刷（禽鸟自我理羽、剔除虮虱；西语谓“禽鸟自行除虱”）
entries.en: to preen itself / pick off lice (said of a bird)
to preen its feathers (bird delousing itself)

entries.zh: （任何牲畜）自行除虱、蹭痒；汉字栏字迹难辨（“扔/打…瓦”），字面义未详
entries.en: any animal delousing itself (rubbing/scratching); Chinese gloss unclear
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字“扔/打”难辨且“瓦”字义不合，释义以 L 栏 espulgarse qual quier animal 为据
M 栏首字两读存疑（Pǔe/Bǔe），字义“沫”与 Espuma 互证明确；按有[疑]之规降为中

entries.en: squad of soldiers; soldiers drawn up in ranks

entries.zh: 曲尺（木匠量直角用的矩尺；西语谓“木匠量具、用以量度”）
entries.notes: M 栏残损（[残] J. quiǒck），释义据 L 栏与第 11 条“曲尺”互证，置信从低

entries.zh: 曲尺（木匠的矩尺，曲角之尺；旁注谓其形如棒杖）
entries.en: carpenter's square (L-shaped rule); marginal note compares it to a staff

entries.zh: 矩尺（汉字疑“隅/矩”；木匠量直角之尺；旁注小字 cincha 义未详）
entries.en: carpenter's square / measuring square (characters uncertain: 隅/矩; marginal note “cincha” = girth/strap, sense unclear)
entries.notes: 汉字栏“隅/矩”难辨；旁注 cincha（围带）与词头关系未详

entries.zh: 屈尺（汉字疑“屈/届”；量度用之尺、曲尺一类；旁注小字 luerra 义未详）
entries.en: measuring square/rule (first character uncertain: 屈/届; marginal note “luerra” of unclear sense)
entries.notes: 汉字栏“屈/届”难辨且旁注 luerra 未详，释义从 L 栏“量度之尺”

entries.zh: 阵（战阵、行列阵形；西语谓军队编组及行列之数）
entries.en: battle array; squadron; an ordered array/number (of troops)

entries.zh: 排兵（列兵成排、布列之兵）
entries.en: troops drawn up in ranks; to array soldiers in ranks

entries.zh: 石头阵（步卒结成的战阵；西语词头尾部辨读不明）
entries.en: “stone array” — squadron of men on foot (Spanish tail “o q̃ haven los hetchos” unclear)
entries.notes: L 栏尾部 o q̃ haven los hetchos 辨读不明（hetchos 未详），字义据 H/M 栏“石頭陣”
